8. [EVENT] User is seeking recommendations on how to choose the right paint finish for their bedroom walls, emphasizing durability and ease of cleaning.
9. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested paint finishes include:
   - Matte (Flat) Finish: Soft, subtle look but not very durable.
   - Eggshell Finish: Slightly higher sheen, more durable and easier to clean.
   - Satin Finish: Popular choice, balances durability and appearance.
   - Semi-Gloss Finish: Highly reflective and durable, suitable for trim work.
10. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided factors to consider when choosing a paint finish, including traffic and use, moisture, lighting, and personal preference.
11. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended eggshell or satin finish for durability and ease of cleaning.
12. [EVENT] User requests suggestions for popular paint brands that offer high-quality, low-VOC, mildew-resistant, and stain-resistant paints.
13. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested popular paint brands:
   - Benjamin Moore: Natura and Aura lines.
   - Behr: Premium Plus ULTRA and Marquee lines.
   - Sherwin-Williams: ProMar 200 and Harmony lines.
